request.purpose: We want to improve the delivery of care by finding regions where guideline-recommended treatment is under-used.
request.question: Among adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity, what share has an active SGLT2 inhibitor, by sex?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Obesity = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E66.
SGLT2 inhibitor = ATC code starting with A10BK.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Cohort = adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity.
Report per sex: patients in the cohort and % of them with an active SGLT2 inhibitor, one decimal.
